what.km: ភាពបៃតងនៃដី (NDVI)

definition.en: A satellite measure of living plants, called NDVI. Healthy leaves reflect much more near-infrared light than red light, and NDVI compares the two. It runs from about 0 for bare ground, rock or sand to near 1 for thick forest, averaged over the year. Water and snow read below 0.
definition.km: រង្វាស់ពីផ្កាយរណបអំពីរុក្ខជាតិរស់ ហៅថា NDVI។ ស្លឹកឈើមានសុខភាពល្អ ចាំងពន្លឺអ៊ីនហ្វ្រារ៉េដជិតច្រើនជាងពន្លឺក្រហមឆ្ងាយ ហើយ NDVI ប្រៀបធៀបពន្លឺទាំងពីរនេះ។ វាមានតម្លៃពីប្រហែល 0 សម្រាប់ដីទទេ ថ្ម ឬខ្សាច់ ដល់ជិត 1 សម្រាប់ព្រៃក្រាស់ យកជាមធ្យមក្នុងមួយឆ្នាំ។ ទឹក និងព្រិលមានតម្លៃក្រោម 0។

km: រុក្ខជាតិដុះច្រើនជាង
ដីមិនសូវបៃតង
រុក្ខជាតិដុះតិចជាង

en: An average over a big grid cell mixes forest, fields, towns and water.
Greener is not always better: a plantation or a weedy field can read as green as the forest it replaced.
Thick forest is near the top of the scale already, so more growth there hardly shows.
km: តម្លៃមធ្យមលើក្រឡាធំ លាយព្រៃ វាលស្រែ ទីក្រុង និងទឹកចូលគ្នា។
បៃតងជាងមិនមែនតែងតែល្អជាងទេ៖ ចម្ការដាំ ឬវាលស្មៅ អាចបៃតងស្មើនឹងព្រៃដែលវាជំនួស។
ព្រៃក្រាស់នៅជិតកំពូលនៃមាត្រដ្ឋានរួចហើយ ដូច្នេះការលូតលាស់បន្ថែមនៅទីនោះ ស្ទើរតែមើលមិនឃើញ។

docs16_rows: | `modis-mod13c2` | MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices Monthly L3 Global 0.05° CMG V061 (MOD13C2) | NASA LP DAAC | 10.5067/MODIS/MOD13C2.061 | ndvi |
notes:
Download route: NASA Earthdata cloud OPeNDAP (opendap.earthdata.nasa.gov, Hyrax) with dap4.ce on the NDVI SDS only, as netCDF-4 (~9 MB per month instead of the ~95 MB HDF4 with 13 SDS). The brief prefers OPeNDAP subsetting. So pyhdf is not used; the values were checked identical to the HDF4 read for 2001-01 (max diff 5e-8). Granules come from CMR (C2565788914-LPCLOUD), 288 months 2001-01..2024-12, all present.
Scaling: raw int16 x 0.0001, valid >= -2000; fill -3000 skipped. The file's scale_factor attribute is 10000 in the MODIS divide convention, so the script turns off netCDF auto-scaling and scales by hand.
Order: each month is binned to 1° at once (mean of the 0.05° pixel centres in the cell, like bin1, via bin1 itself) and cached as tools/cache/ndvi/YYYY-MM.npy (64800 float32); the year = nanmean of the 12 monthly 1° values. This equals 'yearly mean of 12 months, then mean to 1°' wherever a cell has no fill months. Where it has some (polar night, persistent snow), the year averages only the months with data, so high-latitude cells lean to summer. A year needs all 12 granules (all present).
Coverage: 29.3% of cells finite every year. Antarctica is NaN (fill in MOD13C2). Range -0.20..0.98. Global land means (cos-lat weighted over finite cells) 2001 0.404, 2012 0.411, 2024 0.422.
Cambodia cells (lat 10-14, lon 102-107): 2001 0.650, 2012 0.653, 2024 0.633. Flat to slightly down; MODIS saturates over dense forest, so forest loss to plantations shows only weakly.
MOD13C2 is Terra only; Terra's orbit drift after 2022 is a known minor effect on V061. first_year 2001 (the record starts Feb 2000, so 2000 is incomplete and outside the grid anyway).
No new threshold for stats.T. Unit 'NDVI' follows the 'AOD' style of aerosol. Bytes downloaded: 2,640,465,743 for the 288 subsets (plus about 0.2 GB of HDF4 and subset retries before the switch). The script needed two robustness fixes during the run: retry when Earthdata answers 200 with an HTML login page, and a lock around netCDF reads (the HDF5 C library segfaulted with 4 reader threads).
